decisions.reason: Retaining the hover animations does not change the source, quantity, or use of the gallery portfolio images.
The pricing-table decision is a separate clause already represented by its own same-message MODIFY and is not a consequence of retaining hover animations.
The hover-animation policy does not alter the homepage buttons or their page destinations.
Retaining gallery hover animations does not change the required number or presentation contexts of pricing bundles.
The animation decision does not change the square-footage pricing model, tiers, or package prices.
Gallery hover animations and the homepage hero overlay are independent visual behaviors; the source decision does not change the overlay.
